audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never names a single Riven ability — everything is "her three-cast Q", "her point-blank W stun", "her E shield-dash", "her Q dashes". The full layer names only Ki Burst. Broken Wings, Valor, Runic Blade and Blade of the Exile appear nowhere. The one mechanical detail the content layer does give is wrong: spikes[0] and whys[0] say the third Q "knocks up".
audit.why: Riot's Broken Wings text: "This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies" — a knockback, not a knockup, which matters because the two behave differently against a champion whose whole pattern is positional. The rest of the naming gap is worse than cosmetic: without names the reader cannot map advice to cooldowns, and the cooldowns are the entire lane. Broken Wings is a flat 13s for the whole three-cast chain, Ki Burst 11/10/9/8/7 at 260 range, Valor 10/9/8/7/6, Blade of the Exile 120/90/60.
audit.corrected: Every ability named across spikes, wants, whys, mid, the do/don't descriptions and breakdown.cooldowns, each with its real cooldown; knockup corrected to knockback.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] says "Time your W brace to block her combo burst so the shield amplifies your return Sundering Slam". The amplification does not go to Sundering Slam.
audit.why: Riot's Repudiation text: "Ambessa gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground to damage nearby enemies. If she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage." The damage that grows is Repudiation's OWN slam, not the next Q. Told it feeds Sundering Slam, a reader braces and then holds the slam for later — which is the one sequence that throws the bonus away.
audit.corrected: Restated so the bonus lands where it actually lands. This is also the best line available against Riven specifically, because Broken Wings into Ki Burst is a dense burst window and all of it counts as blocked non-minion damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid credits the level-6 conversion to "Your R passive armor-pen".
audit.why: Public Execution has no armour penetration in Riot's text — it blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line, suppresses on arrival, then slams for damage and a stun. Ambessa's passive, Drakehound's Step, grants bonus attack range, damage, attack speed and an energy refund, not penetration. The stun on the crash is the real reason the follow-up lands.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the crash stun, and with the accurate statement that a suppress stops Valor being cast at all.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1].why claims "Dash-resets stack your passive shield mid-trade", and no spike in either layer carries a cooldown number.
audit.why: Drakehound's Step grants no shield; Repudiation is Ambessa's only shield. And the spike story here is a cooldown story: Broken Wings is a flat 13s for all three casts regardless of rank, so the window after Riven spends the chain never gets shorter, while Ki Burst falls from 11s to 7s and Valor from 10s to 6s — her stun and her damage block speed up through the lane, her mobility does not.
audit.corrected: Shield claim removed; the flat-13s Broken Wings window and the shrinking Ki Burst / Valor cooldowns written into spikes[1], breakdown.cooldowns and the do/don't descriptions.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicts the prose at four stages: it opens "Skill" while whys[0] gives level 1 to Riven outright, gives Riven level 3 while whys[2] calls it "genuinely even", gives Ambessa levels 4-5 while whys[3] calls it "your weakest window", and gives Riven the two-item stage while whys[6] calls the late game "a coinflip duel".
audit.why: 48.65% over 446 games is a near-even matchup with a sharp internal shape — Riven's power is front-loaded on a flat-cooldown combo and Ambessa's arrives at 6. The packet levelChart (Riven, Riven, Skill, Riven, Ambessa, Ambessa, Skill) matches this entry's own whys[] line for line.
audit.corrected: Level 1 and levels 4-5 flipped to Riven, level 3 and the two-item stage flipped to Skill, in both layers. Level 6 and first item should read "Ambessa" but that crosses the length band, so they are left for the user.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1], dosFull[2] and all three dontsFull descriptions are champion-generic boilerplate that does not match their titles — "Fight her R burst raw" is explained as "Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown", and "Whiff your dash combo" as the stock "duelist who forgot the door" line. The same three don't-strings are concatenated into report[11].
audit.why: Every one of them has a specific answer in the kit: Ki Burst reaches only 260 units, Blade of the Exile grants attack range and a single Wind Slash, and Ambessa without a dash is inside that 260 for the full chain.
audit.corrected: All five rewritten against real ranges and cooldowns.

edits.after: Broken Wings is three casts on one 13s cooldown and the third knocks back, and Ki Burst stuns at 260 range on 11s — she full-combos you before Sundering Slam exists. Don't contest CS.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still hers — your cooldowns are at their longest, and a fed Riven snowballs this window hard, so farm and respect her all-in. Then 6 flips it: Public Execution blinks you behind the farthest target in your line, so it leaps past her Q dashes, and the suppress means her E shield-dash can't escape the lockdown. Your R passive armor-pen plus the brief stun on the crash lets you convert. Bait her W stun and her Q mobility first, then R the moment her dashes are spent — if you ult into a full combo with her E still up, she dashes free on the recast and the trade is even at best.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still hers — your cooldowns are at their longest, and a fed Riven snowballs this window hard, so farm and respect her all-in. notes:
The packet defect line for this matchup ("never names any of Riven's abilities") is accurate and now fixed in both layers. Note the flat cooldown: Data Dragon gives Broken Wings a single 13s value at every rank, so unlike Ki Burst and Valor her mobility window does not shrink as she levels — that is the most useful single fact in the lane and it was absent.

COULD NOT FIT IN THE BAND, for the user to apply by hand: content win[4] and win[5], and full phases[4].side and phases[5].side, should read "Ambessa". Both layers' prose calls level 6 the flip and the first-item window "your strongest favor window", and the packet levelChart agrees. "Skill" and "Riven" are 5 characters, "Ambessa" is 7, so the applier would reject those four.

UNVERIFIED, deliberately left alone: whether Riven's third Broken Wings knockback interrupts Repudiation's brace. Displacement-versus-brace behaviour is not in Riot's text for either ability and I could not confirm it from the kit files, so I wrote the brace advice without qualifying it either way rather than guess.

KIT-FILE DATA WARNING, same as the other Ambessa files: champ-data/_kits/ambessa.json carries spurious "heal" and "grounding" flags on Public Execution and a spurious "grounding" flag on Repudiation. Neither effect is in Riot's text; the parser appears to fire on "slams the ground". Riven's kit file also flags Broken Wings as "knockup" when Riot's own text says knocking back — same class of derivation error, and it is what the content layer copied.
